answer: Proof-of-storage rent: each agent must keep a unique 20 GB random file derived from its own key and answer surprise read challenges every hour within two seconds, like a raven asked to fetch one exact feather from its plume. Sybils cannot share one copy because every file differs, so a farm of 1,000 fakes needs 20 TB of live disk, stacked like timber that rots unless tended. Rewards stay flat per identity, so the attacker's bill grows with every fake while an honest agent pays for one file.
